flow.aria: Conversion fees and Fund Wallet fees go to FeeVault. The owner can withdraw; in S3, fees fund $SPARE buybacks and stakers.

steps.convert: Your spare change converts into stock → 0.25% of the USDG converted goes to FeeVault.

outcomes.title: What the outcomes mean
outcomes.bought: Bought — tokens delivered to your wallet, fee taken.
outcomes.deferred: Deferred — market closed, stale or paused price, a quote or pool problem. Your USDG goes back to the park, untouched, and is retried next time. No fee.
outcomes.safeSettled: Safe-settled — only if Spare deactivates a stock that's in your mix: that part is sent to you as USDG, with a notice. No fee.

meta.description: Spare contract addresses, ABIs, events and code for Robinhood Chain; the keeper; a local mainnet fork; and the Spare MCP.

hero.title: Build on Spare
hero.subtitle: Everything Spare does is a contract call on Robinhood Chain. Addresses, ABIs, events and working snippets.

overview.body: Spare S1 is eight core contracts plus two park adapters on Robinhood Chain mainnet. Everything a user does — link, rule, mix, exit — is a direct call from their wallet. Collection and sweeps are keeper calls. All state is public.

addresses.body: Every address links to Robinhood Chain's Blockscout explorer. The code column checks for deployed bytecode, live.
addresses.ownerKeyBody: Owner, pauser and attestor are the same single wallet at launch: no multisig and no timelock. What it can and can't do is spelled out in Docs · Risks.
addresses.recordNote: The deployment record: contracts, roles, stock tokens, park adapters. Source for all of this: <mono>spare_contracts</mono> in Spare MCP.

abis.body: ABIs are generated from the Foundry build (<mono>contracts/out-deploy</mono>) by <mono>scripts/gen-spare-abis.mjs</mono> into <mono>src/lib/spare-chain/abis.ts</mono>. Each download below is that exact JSON.

read.body: Reads need no wallet: any viem client pointed at the public RPC.
read.mathIntro: Round-up math (matches the contract and keeper exactly):

write.body: Every user action is one call from the user's own wallet. Set up a wallet client once; the calls below use <mono>wallet</mono>, <mono>account</mono> (the Spare account) and, for pull approvals, <mono>spenderWallet</mono> / <mono>spender</mono> (the spending wallet).

what.linkSelf: Link the account's own wallet as a spending wallet. One transaction.
what.linkWallet: Link another wallet. The spending wallet signs EIP-712 first — domain "SPARE RuleRegistry" v1, type Link(address account,address wallet,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline) — then the account submits.
what.setRule: Round to $1, $5 or $10, a 1×–5× multiplier and a weekly cap in USDG base units (0 turns collection off).
what.unlink: Stop collecting from a wallet. The account or the wallet itself can call it.
what.setMix: Up to 6 active stocks, weights summing to exactly 10,000 bps.
what.clearMix: Drop your mix; the default mix (60% SPY / 40% NVDA) applies.
what.exit: Withdraw all parked spare as USDG. Not pausable.
what.claim: Claim tokens held for you after a refused delivery.
what.permit2: The pull approval, from each spending wallet: USDG to Permit2 once, then a Permit2 allowance for SweepExecutor. Your weekly cap bounds every pull.

events.body: Every state change emits an event. Index them from the deploy block ({{block}}).

meaning.accrued: A linked wallet's round-ups for a block range were pulled and credited to the account.
meaning.accrualSkipped: One collection in a keeper batch was skipped (cap, allowance, balance or window); reason holds the revert data.
meaning.accountSwept: An account's parked spare went into this epoch's sweep.
meaning.assetSwept: One netted swap for a stock: USDG in, the fee sent to FeeVault, the tokens bought.
meaning.delivered: Bought tokens (or safe-settled USDG) were sent to the account.
meaning.deliveryHeld: A transfer to the account was refused; the amount is held for it to claim.
meaning.deferred: A leg waited (status is the oracle status); the account's USDG went back to the park.
meaning.safeSettled: A deactivated stock's leg was paid to the account as USDG.
meaning.swapDeferred: A stock's netted swap did not run (limit, quote, pool or oracle band); the USDG went back to the park.
meaning.paramsSet: The owner set the finality buffer, threshold, fee, slippage and epoch length.
meaning.credited: Collected USDG was credited to the account as pending spare.
meaning.parked: Pending USDG moved into the park adapter.
meaning.withdrawnForSweep: An account's spare left the park for a sweep.
meaning.returned: A deferred leg's USDG came back to the account in the park.
meaning.exited: The account withdrew all its parked spare.
meaning.exitUnitsKept: Park units that couldn't be redeemed or handed over stay booked to the account; exit again later.
meaning.ruleSet: The account set its round-to, multiplier, weekly cap and on/off.
meaning.linked: A spending wallet was linked to the account.
meaning.nonceInvalidated: A wallet cancelled its outstanding link signatures.
meaning.mixSet: The account set its stock mix.
meaning.mixCleared: The account cleared its mix; the default applies.
meaning.defaultMixSet: The owner set the default mix.
meaning.assetSet: A stock's feed, heartbeat, oracle band and pinned pool were set.
meaning.assetActive: A stock was activated or deactivated.
meaning.bought: USDG was swapped into a stock through its pinned pool (with the oracle price the band was checked against).
meaning.sold: A stock was swapped back into USDG through its pinned pool.
meaning.withdrawn: The owner withdrew fees: token, recipient, amount.
meaning.cleared: An account received an eligibility clearance, valid until a time.
meaning.enforcedSet: Eligibility enforcement was switched on or off.

errors.body: Custom errors, decoded against every Spare ABI plus Permit2, and the sentence the Spare app shows for each (example arguments).
errors.title: Custom errors
errors.other: Other errors (admin paths and library internals) show as their name and arguments: {{list}}.

keeper.body: The keeper (<mono>engine/src/keeper</mono>, <mono>bun run keeper</mono>) is stateless: cursors live on-chain. Collect every 60 s: find accounts from <mono>Linked</mono> events, scan each wallet's outgoing USDG transfers in its window, apply the exclusions, clamp to cap/allowance/balance, send one <mono>accrueBatch</mono>. Sweep every 10 min: accounts over threshold, not swept this epoch, eligible, mix oracle-OK, inside market hours → net per stock → V4Quoter → <mono>sweep(accounts, limits)</mono>.
keeper.gasHint: ETH the keeper pays collections and sweeps with
keeper.partial: Some reads didn't answer; a value may be missing until the next refresh.

about.title: About these tokens
about.body: Stock tokens are ERC-20 tokens issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited that track the underlying. They are not shares. Prices here are per token and already include the token's multiplier. Chainlink updates stock prices during the US-equities 24/5 session; outside it, the last close is shown and sweeps wait. Not offered to US persons.
